Two fits. Three colours.

Some days call for a familiar straight shape. Some call for a little more room. KOVA’s proposed Everyday and Oversized tees give those ideas a place to start.

The concept prices are ₹699 for Everyday and ₹899 for Oversized. Ink, Chalk and Sage make up the proposed palette. These are fictional prices, not items available to purchase.

Before any real launch, we would publish measured size charts, verified fabric details, delivery costs and return terms. For now, explore the idea.
